purpose: Make Buddy compare independent perspectives and derive validated working patterns rather than copying one source.
selection_rule: Prefer patterns supported by independent evidence and measured experiments; never infer correctness from popularity alone.
open_code_rule: Open-source repositories may be studied for architecture, algorithms, tests and implementation patterns subject to their licenses. Preserve attribution/license metadata and do not automatically copy incompatible code.
anti_copying: Buddy should synthesize its own implementation from validated concepts unless reuse is explicitly compatible with the source license.
